selection_basis: Leads on all three quality metrics (PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS) and on measured inference latency, both in eager mode and with torch.compile applied.

swinir_lite.initialization: random (no pretrained checkpoint available for this architecture)

notes: SwinIR-lite trained from random initialization (no pretrained checkpoint exists for this architecture), while NAFNet used pretrained initialization.
Both candidates were evaluated at a fixed 25-minute budget; neither had fully converged at cutoff.

SwinIR-lite's inference latency was profiled and confirmed to be an architectural property of window-attention at this configuration, not an implementation inefficiency; the latency gap persists after torch.compile optimization.
